describe: change some words on the page, including on a button, a card, the tagline or the footer
_note: Deterministic for the three parts a child names most -- the tagline, the footer, the one button -- when the words are spelled out. Measured need: three certain requests in the first label set went to Gary only because this recipe guided. Everything else (a card, a paragraph, words not given) is still Gary's, with the guide.
guide: Find the exact words in src/index.html and change only the text between the tags. Keep the tags themselves exactly as they are, and use edit_file with the one line that holds the words.
report: I changed the words of $part to “$words”.
teach: The words sit between the opening and closing tags in index.html; the tags themselves say what kind of thing it is.
